desc: Derive and verify the graph traversal invariant `dist[v] = A[root] XOR A[v]`, including contradiction detection for cycles and self-loops.
Develop the per-connected-component minimization proof showing that each binary bit of the root value can be optimized independently by counting set bits.
Determine the required bit range from `Z_i <= 10^9` and confirm bounds for resulting values and sums.
Implement an `O(N + M + B*N)` iterative DFS/BFS solution using adjacency lists, component vertex collection, XOR consistency checks, and bitwise offset optimization.
Prepare robust Python stdin/stdout handling for `M = 0`, disconnected graphs, duplicate constraints, self-loops, and impossible instances.
